steps.en: Notices due for the 2nd letter and not suspended are selected
steps.id: Notice yang jatuh tempo untuk surat ke-2 dan tidak disuspend dipilih
steps.why_en: Daily letter run is switched off in code; letters only go out when triggered by hand
steps.why_id: Job surat harian dimatikan di code; surat hanya keluar kalau dipicu manual

steps.en: The letter uses the owner's latest address; notices without an address are held back
steps.id: Surat memakai alamat terbaru pemilik; notice tanpa alamat ditahan

steps.en: A data file for the 2nd letter is prepared for the printing vendor
steps.id: File data surat ke-2 disiapkan untuk vendor cetak

steps.en: The file is sent to the vendor over a secure file transfer
steps.id: File dikirim ke vendor lewat transfer file aman
steps.why_en: The production settings block uploads to this vendor, yet notices still move on as if the file had been sent.
steps.why_id: Pengaturan produksi memblokir upload ke vendor ini, tetapi notice tetap maju seolah file sudah terkirim.
